name: Netherlands
visaRequirements: Schengen visa rules apply for many travelers; check current requirements before booking
bestExperience: Best experience: exploring Giethoorn by small boat, gliding along its quiet, car-free canals.

about.description: The Netherlands mixes vibrant cities, blooming tulip fields, and peaceful canals. It is easy to explore by train, bike, or boat.

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: March to May for tulips, or September to October for mild weather and fewer crowds
transportation: Bicycles are one of the best ways to explore
Regional buses and trams connect small towns
culturalNotes: Try local cheeses and street food like stroopwafels
Respect cycling lanes—they are used aggressively
Take time to visit a museum or a canal boat tour
